adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the constructed `evt: CalendarEvent` includes `organizer`, `attendees`, `uid`, `location`, etc., but never sets a `team` field (nor does it fetch/include team members). In `sendAddGuestsEmails` (`packages/emails/email-manager.ts`), team notifications are only sent inside `if (calendarEvent.team?.members) { ... }`, so based on the diff alone that loop will not run and team members won’t be emailed for team bookings. The second clause about `OrganizerAddGuestsEmail` subject falling back to organizer/team name isn’t supported by the shown organizer email template (it uses `this.calEvent.attendees[0].name`), but the dead team-member notification path is a verifiable behavior issue from the diff.
